name: Arien Suggestion 1
title: Free spirits & handmade things
description: My strongest match for you: old traditions, personal stories, playful making, and Caribbean food. A reflective evening with things to take home, rather than a drinking-focused night.
practical: Central Amsterdam on foot. Five venues, 19:00–23:20. The 21:00 smudgestick session is the anchor. Have a snack before starting; the main food stop is at 21:45. Tarot is an optional €15 extra; food and other unpublished prices are separate. Arrival targets are flexible except the marked session.

route.reason: Explore an unusual historic collection and approach a tarot reading as a cultural experiment.
route.practical: Optional 10-minute flash reading: €15. If you would rather skip it, explore the collection or Cymatics lab instead.

route.reason: Try Ebru paper marbling: traditional craft, unpredictable patterns, and a piece you make yourself.
route.practical: The venue is explicitly alcohol-free. Workshop duration and capacity are not specified; adjust locally.
route.transfer: 20 minutes to walk plus 0–15 minutes of spare time from the previous stop.

route.reason: Learn about Moluccan heritage through herbs, family history, and making your own botanical bundle.
route.practical: Official sessions: 21:00–21:30 and 22:00–22:30. Aim to arrive by 20:45 for the first; if full, the second requires rearranging the next stops.
route.transfer: Allow about 25 minutes walking from Fatih, with an additional 10-minute margin before the target arrival.

route.reason: A proper food break with Yvette’s Curaçao-rooted Caribbean cooking, inside a canal-house museum.
route.practical: Food prices, availability, and dietary options are not listed. Buy food separately; leave a little time to look around the house.
route.transfer: About 5–10 minutes walking, with spare time for entry.

route.reason: Turn photographs into an eight-page story using writing, drawing, and collage. A personal creative finish.
route.practical: The activity ends at 23:30. Confirm you can start a workshop at this time; if full, look around Foam’s photography exhibitions.
route.transfer: A short walk along the canal; the plan leaves 15 minutes between stops.

name: Arien Suggestion 2
title: Weird science & living systems
description: For your curious, outside-the-box side: an experimental meal, making something real, urban biodiversity, coded movement, and a cosmic ending.
practical: An east-centre walking route: Mediamatic → NEMO → Arcam → Waag → ARTIS. Five venues, 19:00–00:00. Spoon-making costs €15 extra. Meal price and projection start times are not published in the checked listings; ask on arrival. Bring a bag for anything you make.

route.reason: Start by tasting the experimental menu at TestTafel and discussing biotechnology over dinner.
route.practical: The official listing describes genetically modified food and drink. Check the actual menu, dietary suitability, price, and service pace before ordering.

route.reason: Press a useful steel spoon yourself, then try it with ice cream. A satisfying antidote to passive looking.
route.practical: €15 extra for the spoon, which you keep. If the queue is long, DIY Kettingreactie at NEMO is an alternative.
route.transfer: Leave 20 minutes for the walk and museum entry.

route.reason: Build an insect shelter with a permaculture initiative, bringing ecology and hands-on creativity together.
route.practical: Materials, capacity, and workshop length are not specified. Ask whether the work can be finished within this visit.
route.transfer: About 10 minutes walking, with a small entry margin.

route.reason: Use movement to encode a message and explore how communities communicate around platform restrictions.
route.practical: A playful activity about digital culture and expression. No published fixed session or extra fee in the checked listing.
route.transfer: Allow about 20 minutes walking and a short queue buffer.

route.reason: Finish under the planetarium dome, considering strange future scenarios for Earth and space.
route.practical: 23:15 is a target arrival, not a confirmed screening start. Join the next available projection; the listed activity window lasts until 01:45.
route.transfer: Leave 30 minutes for the walk across the eastern centre and entry.

name: Arien Suggestion 3
title: Art with a rebellious streak
description: Big museums through a less conventional lens: a community meal, reused clothing, feminist shadow puppets, Kusama, clay, and a surreal live atelier.
practical: Mostly Museumplein, finishing near Vondelpark. Five venues and six stops, 19:00–00:45. Bring a cotton T-shirt or tote. Expect museum queues: if running late, skip one workshop rather than rush all six stops. De Sering is vegan; meal prices are not published in the checked listing.

route.reason: Eat with a vegan community kitchen where meeting people is part of the point. A welcoming, social start.
route.practical: This is De Sering’s Museumnacht kitchen at the Van Gogh Museum, not its regular location. Check food prices and the menu.

route.reason: Give an old garment a new design through textile printing, with reuse at the centre of the work.
route.practical: Bring your own cotton T-shirt or bag. The listing says only a limited number of spare shirts are available.
route.transfer: Same museum; keep 10 minutes to find the workshop and join any queue.

route.reason: Make a shadow puppet with an all-women wayang collective, mixing traditional craft with feminist reinterpretation.
route.practical: The programme is explicitly labelled alcohol-free and runs until 22:00. Check how workshop and performance participation work.
route.transfer: Walk across Museumplein and allow for a separate venue entry queue.

route.reason: Look beyond Kusama’s famous patterns into questions of self-image, repetition, and infinity.
route.practical: Find the next available Blikopener tour; 21:50 is not an advertised departure. Listed tours finish at 23:00.
route.transfer: Same building address as Buro Stedelijk, but allow 20 minutes to move between entrances or queues.

route.reason: Make an expressive clay sculpture rather than only looking at art. The activity is labelled low-stimulation.
route.practical: The activity ends at midnight. Ask about places and duration before starting; any extra price is not specified.
route.transfer: Leave 25 minutes for the walk to the Rijksmuseum and entry.

route.reason: End in a historic riding hall with artists working live between observation, imagination, and surreal performance.
route.practical: The listed live-atelier window continues until 02:00, giving this final stop some flexibility.
route.transfer: Allow 30 minutes for the walk toward Vondelpark and the museum entrance.

name: Arien Suggestion 4
title: Go wonderfully weird
description: A lively night of local Amsterdam colour, collective art, graffiti, camp self-expression, and warehouse theatre. Plenty of energy without making alcohol the activity.
practical: West → NDSM. Four venues and five stops, 19:00–01:00. A 70-minute transfer block is reserved for walking, ferry waiting, crossing, and entry; check live GVB routes and the return ferry. The 23:30 theatre performance is fixed. For a calmer Noord-only start, skip Amsterdam in Motion, eat beforehand, and attend Breath of Freedom at Treehouse, 19:30–20:30.

route.reason: Start with a tosti and a dose of local Amsterdam culture in a museum about the city.
route.practical: This is simple canteen food, not a guaranteed full dinner menu. Prices are not published; eat more beforehand if needed. Optional: add your design to the CD-Remix artwork while here.

route.reason: Try your own lines, doodles, or first tag with guidance from STRAAT’s museum educators.
route.practical: Allow time to explore the street-art collection around the workshop. It runs until midnight, so this stop can slide later.
route.transfer: Use the gap from 19:45 to 21:30 for the optional CD artwork and a 70-minute walking/ferry/entry allowance. Check GVB; this is not a live travel estimate.

route.reason: Play with camp, fashion, identity, and a photobooth-catwalk installation; participate as much or as little as you like.
route.practical: The installation runs until 02:00. This stop concerns self-expression rather than a specific live performance.
route.transfer: Allow 15 minutes to walk within NDSM and enter.

route.reason: Watch a performance about masculinity, imitation, empathy, and connection in an artists’ community.
route.practical: The live official listing gives 23:30–00:15. Reach Treehouse by about 23:15 and check seating or admission locally.
route.transfer: A short NDSM walk, with 25 minutes reserved for finding the room and a seat.

route.reason: Finish by drawing with other people: a playful, collaborative decompression after the theatre.
route.practical: A flexible late-night option at Treehouse, listed until 02:00. Skip it if you need an earlier ferry.
route.transfer: Same venue; leave 15 minutes between activities.

alternatives.note: Alternative Noord-only start: 19:30–20:30 breathwork with improvised electronic music. Eat before starting; skip Amsterdam in Motion and meet the main route at STRAAT.
